senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; גלי)exile, esp. (with or without בני) the diaspora, Jews living abroad, esp. Babylonians.
units: R. Hash. 18ᵇ באת שמועה לַגּ׳ the report came to the captivity (in Babylonia); a. fr.—ראש ג׳ (ch. ריש גלותא) chief of the Babylonian Jews, Resh G’lutha.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 38a:2">Snh. 38ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 92a:4">Ḥull. 92ᵃ</cite> <he>ר׳ ג׳ שבבבל</he>; a. e.—<he>עולי ג׳</he> those returning from Babylonian captivity.
